title: memory: shutdown waits on the fold's model call; cancel it instead
description: Quitting after a turn pauses for up to the client's five second budget. Registry.Close calls the memory plugin's CloseContext, which waits for in flight folds, and a fold is a model call to the summarizer under foldTimeout. The bundle has no git remote here, so it is not the push. The fold is already resumable: RunFoldJob checkpoints only on success and FoldDue re-runs it next start, so shutdown should cancel the summarizer's context and wait only for what is local and half written. Bounds to keep: no concept left partly written, no commit left unmade.

title: tui: markdown and syntax colors are not theme roles, so bright red appears outside errors

Bright red is for errors only: map glamour's style onto the theme's roles the way spans already are, and pick a diff_del that is not the error color, so a deletion and a failure do not read the same.

title: plugin: hooks at process lifecycle stages, not just session ones
description: Hook points today are all session and turn shaped. Add process lifecycle points a plugin can attach to: pre_start and post_start around the build (plugins loaded, registry refreshed, before the first session), and pre_shutdown and post_shutdown around the unwind, so a plugin can warm a cache, announce itself, flush or push without hanging its work off a session it does not have. Each point needs its payload, its timeout and its failure rule in the contracts before code, and pre_shutdown has to say what happens when the caller's budget is already spent.

title: protocol: a read only view of past sessions for plugins

Give plugins a bounded read: list summaries and read a session's entries, so folding is something a plugin can do rather than something the shipped one is handed.

title: protocol: a plugin can ask for a completion without opening a session
description: Memory's fold needs a model call and takes one as a Go func from the kernel, which is the one thing that makes it a special case rather than a plugin. A plugin can open a child session and submit, the way subagents do, but that produces a session log, a turn and tool access for what is a one shot summary, and the fold runs after its session's log is closed. Add provider.complete in the plugin to server direction, bounded and without a session, so any memory implementation can satisfy the same port.

title: tui: any inline frame that shrinks strands its rows on screen (the picker, the slash menu)
description: In inline mode a picker grows the live frame; the terminal scrolls, and closing the picker repaints below the rows it left, so the picker's rows stay in scrollback as ghosts. Reproduced under tmux in TUI Task 10's real path. Same mechanism ADR 0013 decision 4 uses to commit rows. Fix candidates: a constant-height inline frame (the picker replaces the editor slot at the editor's height and scrolls inside it), or a Bubble Tea change. Altscreen is unaffected.
notes:
Reproduced 2026-09-09 under a pty with ui.render=inline, rudy at cb6da2a. Opening the slash menu on a fresh session grows the live frame by 9 rows; typing the draft past a command name closes it, and 8 of the 9 rows stay ON SCREEN above the new frame, not just in scrollback. The 9th is overwritten because the shrunk frame is redrawn at the bottom of where the tall one sat.

Mechanism, from charm.land/bubbletea/v2@v2.0.9 cursed_renderer.go flush(): an inline view sizes the renderer's cell buffer to the frame's own height (frameArea.Max.Y = content.Height()), erases and repaints only that area, and drops buffer lines from the top when the frame is taller than the terminal. Nothing owns the rows a taller frame occupied once it shrinks, so nothing erases them. Not specific to the picker: every inline frame height change has it, and the editor growing and shrinking with a multi-line draft strands a row too (invisible only because the stranded row is the near-empty prompt row).

So the fix has to bound the inline frame's height rather than any one component's: a constant-height live region, where the picker, the menu and the editor scroll inside their slot instead of adding rows. v2.0.9 is the newest v2, so there is no upstream bump to wait for.

Not what a default install meets any more: ADR 0015 made altscreen the default, and altscreen is unaffected.

server: claimCloseIfIdle TryLock loses the close on a transient set_* hold; provider.complete row lacks is_error
description: From the final re-review. claimCloseIfIdle reads any held ls.mu as busy, but only s.compact and runTurn re-run closeIfUnusedLocked afterwards; setModel and setEntry hold ls.mu across an fsynced append, so a last-subscriber detach landing in that window leaves the session live with zero connections, holding the flock, never firing session_closed, until Shutdown. Reachable only through a connection calling set_* on a session it is not attached to (the contract says any attached; nothing enforces it). Fix: re-run closeIfUnusedLocked after setModel and setEntry release the lock, or enforce attached on set_*. Also: docs/specs/rudy-contracts.md provider.complete row must list is_error (and tool_use_id) on messages, which provider.Message now carries on the plugin wire.

Decide whether a fork fires session_opened with Resumed false or a new resumed flavour, then fire it before installAndAttach.

title: memory: the finalize fold's note never lands; the session log is closed before the background fold ends
description:
Real path, task 15, step 11. The memory plugin folds on session_closed with finalize=true. fireSessionClosed fires the hook and returns as soon as handlers return; the memory plugin starts the fold on its own goroutine (startFold) and returns immediately, then closeClaimed calls ls.sess.Close() and the server deletes the session from s.live. Seconds later RunFoldJob finishes and p.note() calls plugin.append_note, which handleAppendNote answers not_found (errSessionNotOpen). The plugin drops it: `_ = p.host.Note(id, text, role)`.

Observed: session 01M22RD2T9HE8HKBQAM75Q6Z7H folded at 2026-09-09T09:37:51Z, wrote one observation and the summary
projects/github.com/guygrigsby/rudy/session-summaries/20260909T093628Z-rudy-cline-pass-kimi-k3.md, and its entries.jsonl has no note entry of any kind. Every rudy -p session today is the same: the summaries land, no note ever does.

A mid-turn fold's note would land (the session is live then), but with ObserveAfterTokens defaulting to 8000 a headless run never reaches one, so in practice the note is unreachable.

Decide who keeps a session open for a plugin's background work: either the server holds the session until in-flight plugin jobs drain (a contract change: session_closed handlers currently only get hook_timeout_ms), or the memory plugin stops promising a note for the finalize fold and says so in the contracts.

title: cli: rudy serve releases the socket lock before its sessions on shutdown
description: serve.go closes the listener (unlinking the socket and dropping the flock) up to the shutdown budget before b.Close releases the session locks. A restart inside that window binds cleanly and answers unavailable for every session the dying process still holds, naming itself in data.socket. Fix needs the protocol.Listener to split stop-accepting from release-the-lock, so the lock is held until the sessions are closed. Serve wave Task 5 review.

title: server: a parent's askers do not cover a child session's standing question on detach or attach
description: Task 3 of the serve wave routes a child session's question to its parent's askers when it has none (the child binding). Two gaps, documented on abandonStanding: when the parent's last asker detaches, the child's standing question is not abandoned (no parent to child pointer), and a newcomer attaching to the parent is not told about the child's standing question. Fix needs the parent to track its live children.

description: ADR 0013 decision 5 omits tui.input.tab and tui.input.copy while the contracts keys row points at it as authoritative; the contracts table has no ui.double_press_ms row for the alias config.Load accepts; the plan's Interfaces block still says the twelve roles with a RoleCode constant, plan:281 says chroma:tokyonight, plan:195 says Restore is newest-first (code is oldest first, draft last). Supersede or amend ADR 0013 by an ADR, fix the contracts row, leave the plan as history with a note.

title: tui: app.editor.external is bound and unimplemented
description: ctrl+g is in the closed key set and does nothing. The plan defers it to the serve wave (process control while the TUI is suspended). Implement with tea.ExecProcess on $EDITOR over a temp file holding the draft.

title: tui: wire or unbind app.suspend, tui.editor.undo and tui.input.copy
description: Bound with pi's defaults and dead: tui.editor.undo (ctrl+-) and tui.input.copy are matched nowhere, and tui.input.copy is shadowed by app.clear on ctrl+c, which is earlier in Actions order. app.suspend was wired in the final fix wave; decide the other two (implement undo through the textarea, copy through OSC 52) or unbind them and shrink ADR 0013's closed set.

title: tui: an expanded failed tool result renders in the text role
description: transcript.expansion paints every result line RoleText whatever the outcome; the outcome line is styled but the body of a failed result is not. Give a failed result's body the error role.

title: tui: tool preview wording is a string contract with the tools plugin
description: cutPrefix and noResults in the transcript hardcode the 'no matches' and cap-marker wording from internal/plugins/tools. Export the strings from one place both import.

title: tui: the editor is one row short until the next keystroke
description: Editor.fit divides text length by width arithmetically while bubbles' textarea wraps on words, so a line that word-wraps early leaves the editor one row short until the next keystroke re-fits it. Use the textarea's own line count.

title: tui: ansi.Truncate counts a tab as one cell in tool previews
description: Read and bash previews are built out of tabs; x/ansi's Truncate counts a tab as one cell, so a preview line with tabs overflows the width. Expand tabs before truncating (tab width as a config field with a default).

title: tui: inline click offset is wrong when the composed frame exceeds the terminal height
description: click computes y -= m.height - len(lines) and goes negative when the live region is taller than the terminal; the click then maps to no row or the wrong one.

title: tui: concurrent registry answers are unsequenced
description: A slow registry.list answer can overwrite a newer registry.refresh result in callResult. Add a generation counter to the registry calls and drop answers older than the newest request.

title: tui: cost reprices the whole session at the current model
description: m.usage accumulates across model_change entries and is priced entirely at m.model.Pricing, so a session that switched models shows a cost that is wrong for every turn before the switch. Price each assistant message at the model that produced it (the entry carries the model ref) and sum.

title: subagents: TestCancelInterruptsTheChildAndWaitsForIt flakes under -race -count>1
description: internal/plugins/subagents: TestCancelInterruptsTheChildAndWaitsForIt passes at -count=1 and flakes under go test -race -count=3 (seen during the plugins wave, re-checked during the TUI wave). Likely the cancel arriving before the child's first turn state or a wait on a closed channel; reproduce with -count=20, pin the ordering with a barrier in the fake child, fix the race in Cancel.
notes: Also flakes at -count=1 under -race (2 of 5 bare runs during the serve wave's Task 8); the title's count>1 qualifier is wrong.

title: provider: the registry lists duplicate model refs from a provider that returns them twice
description: The aperture proxy's /v1/models returns 8 ids twice, and the TUI's model picker lists them twice (TUI Task 10 real path). Decide whether the registry collapses duplicate refs on refresh (one entry per provider:id, first wins) or the picker does; the registry is the right layer since every consumer of registry.list sees them.

title: server: a fork switch closes and cold-reloads a seconds-old fork
description: The TUI switches to a /fork result by session.close then session.resume, because the server already attached the connection in forkAt and subscribeLocked has no dedupe. The close drops the fork to zero connections, closeIfUnusedLocked closes it (session_closed hooks, the memory finalize fold), and the resume cold-loads it and fires session_opened{Resumed:true}. Give the client a way to adopt an already attached session without the round trip: either command.run answers the fork's SessionInfo, or session.resume on a session this connection already holds is a no-op that answers the info. Found in TUI Task 8 review.

title: server: a /fork notice renders twice, sent as both a notification and the command.run result
description: The commands plugin's fork command returns a Notice in the command.run result and the server also emits it as a notification, so a client rendering both shows the notice twice. Found in TUI Task 8. Decide which one carries it (the contract row for command.run says the result) and drop the other.
notes: The TUI stops drawing the result's notice (9517745) as a mitigation; the server still sends both. Root cause: handleCommandRun's four branches call cn.notify(NotifyNotice) and return CommandRunResult{Notice}. Drop the notify; the result carries it per the contract.

title: skills and agentdef: deferred minors
description: agentdef frontmatter error less specific than before the splitter move for some cases; CopyFS recreates symlinks verbatim on migrate; /fork syntax errors map to plugin_error instead of invalid_argument; the clinepass test helper duplicates UnwrapJSON because of the import cycle.

title: mcp: deferred minors
description: headerTransport host equality does not normalize a default port (fails closed); the concurrent connect timing test margin is tight under -race; stdio servers inherit the full parent environment including resolved provider keys (decide whether the configured env table should be the whole environment).

title: pluginstore: deferred minors
description: A duplicate-name install pays for the clone before refusing; a stage mtime is not refreshed during a clone object transfer, so a clone over an hour can be swept by a concurrent install (touch the stage during the clone or take a lock).

title: memory: deferred minors from the memory plugin
description: projects and models entries leak for sessions that never fire session_closed; the fold actor is pinned to the model the session opened with; memory_recall has no limit; a resume landing during a queued finalize deletes the live session entry (memory off until reopen); wg.Add outside the lock and unguarded against Close; Registry.Close not idempotent; memory repo: the rudy fixture note text says folded 0 observations and the fork_point detection branch is untested.

title: provider: deferred minors from the anthropic and openai codecs
description: Vision advertised while image blocks are refused (both codecs); ListModels idle fire not labeled like Complete; unsigned thinking replay bead superseded by the final fix; both codecs pass tool inputs through encoding/json compaction on the wire (bead rudy-k0.24 covers fidelity).

title: plugin: deferred minors from the spawned plugin work
description: Spawned plugins load serially with a 10s init timeout each (connect concurrently like mcp); the command timeout cannot tell its own deadline from a caller deadline; SIGTERM then kill untested against a child that ignores SIGTERM; watch and commit ordering; ToolOwner has no direct unit test; interrupted valid-JSON tool_uses stay pending forever and remain a child capability for their owning plugin (Recovery only backfills allow without result); the Overrides map has no eviction; Shutdown session_closed assertion near vacuous and the failed-plugin-commits-0-hooks check trivial.

title: server: deferred minors from the plugins wave
description: From the final review triage. handleAnswer needs no subscription to the session it answers (scope to attached or a descendant of an attached session); ls.parent never cleared after the tool_result; detach steering cancel races a re-attach; mirror can order a plugin note against a concurrent turn append differently from the log; Host.Connect pipe never reaped when a plugin never calls Close; Fail calls ProvidersChanged unconditionally; s.compact scans Cover twice per explicit compact; malformed parent session id answers invalid_argument where the contract says not_found; compaction under ls.mu should hand the session to rudy serve without TryLock heuristics (I4 follow-up); an abandoned hook handler still lands its side effects after the timeout (M8).

title: memory: bundle check fails on autophage and local/108 indexes written by other harnesses
description:
make check in ~/projects/memory fails TestRealBundle against ~/.agents/memory:

    --- FAIL: TestRealBundle (5.70s)
        realbundle_test.go:27: check: projects/github.com/guygrigsby/autophage/index.md: index differs from regeneration
        realbundle_test.go:27: check: projects/local/108/index.md: missing index
        realbundle_test.go:42: 343 concepts, 0 differ on round trip

Not rudy's: both paths were last written 2026-09-08 (21:07 and 21:34), before any rudy run, and projects/local/108 holds only log.md plus a claude-code session summary, so a claude-code fold made a project directory with no index.md. rudy's own project (github.com/guygrigsby/rudy) is not in the failure list and round-trips clean. Filed here because the rudy wave gates on this check passing.

title: server: plugin.append_note has no ownership check; decide the contract
memory: fold and close timeouts as [memory] config keys
plugin: terminate a spawned plugin's process group, not only the child
plugin: forward tool.progress to clients as stream.delta once a stream part type exists
design: subagent model ladder from registry prices
plugin: spawned plugins registering openai_chat or anthropic_messages providers with endpoint config
mcp: per-session project servers once rudy serve holds many workspaces
mcp: image content blocks through the blob store instead of a text placeholder
memory-go: deferred minors from the whole-branch review
description: Stay-deferred items from the final review of memory-go (memory repo, main at 5488a91): js.Lower final sigma approximates Final_Sigma (Greek ordering only); Check problem order can differ from Node (OS readdir order) when one type dir holds several parse failures; ParseDocument coerces a non-map document to an empty map where Node returns the scalar; the replay never compares refusal messages (stderr not in results.jsonl); hitsJSON (CLI-identical recall JSON) lives in context_test.go and could be promoted if rudy tools must match the CLI; commit subjects on two tasks are not verb-first; Job.Run errors on write.go paths are the caller's to handle (documented in README).

title: server: the socket test harness never closes accepted connections
description: server_test.go socketFor's accept loop hands each conn to srv.Serve and drops it without Close, unlike the production accept loop in serve.go, so RUDY_TEST_TRANSPORT=socket -count=N leaks fds. Close the conn when Serve returns. Serve wave final review.

title: cli: two places spell empty Socket means Paths.Socket()
description: serveSocket in serve.go and Build in wire.go both default an empty socket to paths.Socket(); one helper keeps them from drifting. Serve wave final review.

title: cli: the registry refresh notice lacks the rudy: prefix
description: internal/cli/wire.go:180 prints 'refreshing model registry from <names>' without the rudy: prefix every other notice carries through notices(); wire_test.go pins the unprefixed string. Route it through notices and update the test.

title: server: TestDetachRacesResume flakes once with session unavailable, retry
description: Seen once in pipe mode during the serve wave's Task 7 full-package run; 50 retries and 5 full reruns did not reproduce. Likely the detach/attach claim race narrowing to a retryable unavailable under load. Reproduce with -count=200 under -race, pin, fix.

title: cli: the serve accept loop hot-spins on a persistent accept error
description: serve.go's accept loop logs and retries immediately on any error but net.ErrClosed; under fd exhaustion (EMFILE) it fills the log at loop speed. No timers by rule; bound consecutive failures and return from the loop with an error that shuts the daemon down. Serve wave Task 5 review.

title: session: the no_asker reason string lives in gate and turn as two literals
description: 'no asker attached' is the fixed reason the domain model gives permission_decision{no_asker}. It is spelled in gate.Evaluate (internal/gate/gate.go) and turn.runTool (internal/turn/runner.go) with cross-reference comments after the serve wave's Task 3. Hoist it to one exported const in internal/session beside DecidedBy and use it from both.

title: tui: the edit preview expands a tab to four spaces where the design keeps it
description: default_inline.golden shows the edit tool's preview line as '-    entries' (tab expanded to four spaces) while the design screen block keeps the literal tab. Pre-existing since Task 4 (the transcript's tool preview expands tabs). Decide whether the design or the code is right (a literal tab in a terminal cell grid is width-ambiguous; expansion with a config field for the width is the likely answer) and align the screen block.

title: cli: the pty test's vt drain goroutine outlives the test
description: tui_real_test.go newPtyLog drains the emulator's query replies with io.Copy(io.Discard, emu) in a goroutine that blocks in pr.Read for the life of the process, since nothing calls emu.Close. Close races the drain's unlocked read of e.closed (x/vt Emulator.Read), so the leak was kept. Fix upstream (a locked Read) or end the drain by closing the pipe writer under the log's mutex.

title: keys: New doc says every violation is reported but an unknown id short-circuits
description: internal/tui/keys keys.New collects unknown-action errors and returns before parsing any key string, so a config with both an unknown id and a bad key reports only the id. Either parse both phases and join, or fix the doc.

title: tui: app.Options.Version is written by the launcher and never read
description: model.go: the Version field is set by internal/cli/tui.go and no status item or view reads it. Either a version cell in the status line or drop the field.

title: tui: transcript.committed and Model.seen grow without bound
description: One string per committed turn and one per folded entry for the life of a session. Fine for real sessions; cap or prune (a session switch resets both) if a long-running client ever matters.
